modelo.tipo.text.ayuda: Fixed text you type yourself, like “CPU” or your name.
modelo.tipo.clock.ayuda: The time or today's date, always up to date.
modelo.tipo.sensor.ayuda: Live PC data: CPU usage, GPU temperature, memory…
modelo.tipo.bar.ayuda: A bar that fills up with a PC value (for example, CPU %).
modelo.tipo.image.ayuda: An image of your own (PNG, JPG or GIF), like a logo.
modelo.orientacion.reverse-landscape.ayu: On its side and turned over (180°), in case the display is mounted upside down.
modelo.orientacion.reverse-portrait.ayud: Standing up and turned over (180°), in case the display is mounted upside down.
modelo.validar.reservado: The file uses a name reserved by Windows (CON, NUL, COM1…).
modelo.validar.sensor: Choose a sensor from the list.
modelo.validar.derecha: It goes past the right edge (the screen is {ancho} wide).
modelo.validar.abajo: It goes past the bottom edge (the screen is {alto} high).
modelo.validar.max_min: The maximum must be greater than the minimum.
modelo.validar.traducciones: The translations of this text are not valid.
modelo.validar.traduccion_codigo: “{codigo}” is not a valid language code (two lowercase letters, like “en”).
modelo.validar.traduccion_larga: The “{codigo}” translation is longer than {max} characters.
modelo.http.403: Luzeira refused the request. Close the editor and open it again.
modelo.http.409: This theme can't be changed. Use “Save as…” to make your own copy.
modelo.aplicado.sin_comprobar: Couldn't check how the display is doing.
modelo.aplicado.starting: Done: “{tema}” is being put on the display.
modelo.aplicado.no_display: You'll see it when you connect it.
modelo.aplicado.suspended: You'll see it when the PC wakes up.
modelo.aplicado.stopped: You'll see it when Luzeira starts the display.
modelo.aplicado.simulado: Applied “{tema}” (simulated mode: there's no real display).
modelo.aplicado.problema: But the display has a problem: {mensaje}
modelo.aplicar.pending.texto: To put it on the display, your latest changes have to be saved first.
modelo.aplicar.invalid.texto: Changes with errors can't be saved. Fix the fields marked in red, or put the last saved version on the display.
modelo.aplicar.builtin-changed.texto: Your changes are only kept in a copy of your own. Save it with “Save as…” and it will be applied, or put the original theme on the display.
